answer: Sybil farms stall when admission is a one-shot melt survey. An applicant freezes 5.8 POA in a glacier vault and receives one non-transferable survey ticket. Between minutes 4 and 12 they radio a 20-bit bearing hash of pubkey, epoch seed, and a horizon mark unique to that ticket, then seat a 1.15 L oasis vial on a seed-timed scale. Seventy aliases lock 406 POA and need seventy tickets. Verifiers rebuild the bearing from the seed and reject vials more than 8 g off or reused tickets. A missed window or shared ticket forfeits 38% of the freeze and parks that series for 4 epochs.
